pkgmetadata.longdescription: TypeScript 7, the TypeScript compiler written in Go, built from tsc/ of the TypeScript repository. Slotted per exact version beside ::gentoo's TypeScript 6 (slot 0): installed as /usr/bin/tsc-VERSION, with the compiler and its lib*.d.ts files in /usr/lib/typescript/VERSION/, like upstream's npm platform packages. Primarily a build dependency of www-client/chromium, which pins an exact version.
